meta_description: Punja Painting and Decoration in Leicester. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and specialist finishes. Free quotes, quality guaranteed.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Leicester & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: From fresh walls to full redecoration, we bring colour and finish to Leicester homes. No job too small.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full-house project, we handle interior and exterior work with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Transform any room with professional preparation, primer, and quality paint finishes. We work around your schedule to minimise disruption.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weatherproofing
services.desc: Protect and refresh woodwork, masonry, and render with durable, weather-resistant coatings. All surfaces properly prepared and sealed.

services.title: Feature Walls & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Create visual impact with bold colours, textured effects, and accent walls. We advise on colour schemes and execute with precision.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert hanging of patterned and plain wallpaper, or careful removal of old coverings without damage to plasterwork beneath.

services.title: Ceiling & Woodwork Painting
services.desc: Ceilings, skirting boards, doors, and frames painted to a smooth, professional finish. We use appropriate products for high-traffic areas.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Treatment
services.desc: Thorough sanding, filling, and priming ensures paint adheres properly and lasts. No cutting corners—proper prep makes all the difference.

about_pullquote: I paint homes the way I'd want mine done: carefully, honestly, and without fuss.
about_para_1: Punja Painting and Decoration has been transforming Leicester homes and businesses for over a decade. We started with a simple belief: that a fresh coat of paint shouldn't require a luxury budget or a two-month wait. Over 500 homes and businesses later, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, doing the job right, and leaving your space spotless.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we genuinely listen to what you want—and we're honest when a colour won't work or a surface needs extra prep. We're fully insured, carry all our own equipment, and we pride ourselves on leaving your home cleaner than we found it. Leicester born and based, we know the area and take pride in being the decorator your neighbours recommend.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Punja came to decorate our lounge and kitchen. He turned up bang on time, was tidy and professional throughout, and the finish is absolutely brilliant. No mess, no faffing about, just a quality job. Recommended to three neighbours already.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: We had him paint our entire hallway, stairs, and landing. The colour matching was spot on, he worked around our kids' schedule, and the attention to detail is what impressed me most. Fair price, too. Will definitely book him again.
reviews.author: Rebecca M.

reviews.text: Needed my exterior woodwork and fascia done before winter. Punja assessed it properly, explained what needed doing, and the result is solid. He's not a cowboy trying to upsell you. Honest bloke and does what he says he will.
reviews.author: Mark T.
